era: 2019 expedia.com as every visitor saw it (Arquivo.pt captures January, July and November 2019 agree): yellow #ffcb00 header with the navy Expedia globe logo, 'Add your property' outlined button, Account / My Trips / Support / Español on the right and a second row Flights / Hotels / Bundle and Save / Cars / Cruises / Things to Do / Discover / Vacation Rentals / Deals / Rewards / Mobile; a dark grey search wizard with grey icon tabs (the selected one blue), white labelled fields and a yellow Search button; hotel search results with a map, 'Search by property name', price filter, sort and member-price prompts; hotel pages with a photo gallery, rooms and reviews; footer link columns and country list.

sources.shows: home: yellow header, nav row Flights/Hotels/Bundle and Save/Cars/Cruises/Things to Do/Discover/Vacation Rentals/Deals/Rewards/Mobile, Account menu (Sign In, Create an Account, My Lists, My Trips), Support, Español, wizard tabs 1 of 7, Origin/Destination/dates/Travelers fields, Advanced options, Search, 'The world is a big place' destinations, footer columns and country list
home: same yellow header and dark grey wizard with icon tabs, Flight + Hotel sub-tabs, 'I only need a hotel for part of my stay', Preferred class, yellow Search with 'Save up to $583'
home page as served in 2019-11: same header, wizard, deals and footer
hotel search page: header, search form, map, filters (Search by property name, price, star rating), sort, member-price sign-in prompt, results
hotel search results as served in 2019-09 (capture listed in the Arquivo.pt index)
hotel search page as served in 2019-12
hotel page: gallery, name and stars, price, rooms, amenities, reviews, map
